description: IDS command-line pattern detection rule (Tier2 / LogOnly). Ports the PS script's Invoke-IdsDetection ($Script:IdsPatterns) as a Sentinel IDetectionRule that inspects ProcessTelemetry.CommandLine via case-insensitive compiled regexes for LOLBin/evasion patterns and returns a Tier2Indicator/LogOnly DetectionEvent on match. Modeled exactly on UnsignedBinaryRule, added to Rules.PathProvenance.cs, registered as a transient IDetectionRule in BOTH Service and Agent Program.cs. Independent of FEAT-001 except both edit src/Sentinel.Service/Program.cs; runs after FEAT-001.
steps: Read context.json and this file FIRST; it replaces re-exploration. Then study UnsignedBinaryRule and FullPathParentChildRule in src/Sentinel.Core/Rules.PathProvenance.cs.

In src/Sentinel.Core/Rules.PathProvenance.cs add 'public class IdsCommandLineRule : IDetectionRule' modeled exactly on UnsignedBinaryRule: 'public string Name => "IdsCommandLineRule";', the attribute [RuleCategory(DetectionCategory.SecurityEvasion)] (closest existing enum value for LOLBin/evasion command lines), and 'public DetectionEvent? Evaluate(FusedTelemetryContext context)'.

In Evaluate: 'if (context.TriggeringEvent is not ProcessTelemetry pt) return null;' then 'if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(pt.CommandLine)) return null;'. Match pt.CommandLine against a static readonly (string Name, System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex Rx)[] compiled with RegexOptions.IgnoreCase | RegexOptions.Compiled, covering: certutil -urlcache; bitsadmin /transfer; powershell -enc / -encodedcommand; powershell -w hidden; invoke-expression / 'iex('; downloadstring; downloadfile; net.webclient; -executionpolicy bypass; wmic process call create; reg add HKLM...Run; schtasks /create; netsh firewall; sc create; rundll32 ...dll; regsvr32 /s; mshta http.

On the FIRST matching pattern return new DetectionEvent { RuleName = Name, Tier = DetectionTier.Tier2Indicator, AuthorizedResponse = ResponseAction.LogOnly, Confidence = 0.6, ProcessName = pt.ProcessName, ProcessId = pt.ProcessId, SignalType = SignalType.SuspiciousProcess, Evidence = matched-pattern-name + a truncated command line (cap ~200 chars), Reasoning = explains it is a Tier2 indicator feeding the correlation engine }. Return null when no pattern matches. Regexes MUST be static readonly (compiled once for perf).

Register the rule as a transient IDetectionRule in BOTH src/Sentinel.Service/Program.cs and src/Sentinel.Agent/Program.cs: add services.AddTransient<IDetectionRule, IdsCommandLineRule>(); right next to the existing services.AddTransient<IDetectionRule, UnsignedBinaryRule>(); registration in each file. Match that exact pattern.

Add tests/Sentinel.Tests/IdsCommandLineRuleTests.cs following the AttackPatternTests.cs construction (new FusedTelemetryContext { ProcessId, ProcessName, TriggeringEvent = new ProcessTelemetry { ProcessName, ProcessId, ImagePath, CommandLine } }): malicious lines ('powershell -enc <base64>', 'certutil -urlcache -f http://evil/x') -> Evaluate returns non-null with Tier == DetectionTier.Tier2Indicator and AuthorizedResponse == ResponseAction.LogOnly; a benign line (e.g. 'notepad.exe C:\Users\x\doc.txt') -> null; null/empty CommandLine -> null.
Build and run tests; fix any compile/test errors introduced by this feature.
Set this FEAT's status to 'completed' and record anything the merge step needs in findings. Commit locally on the branch; never push. Do not bump version.txt.
acceptance_criteria: IdsCommandLineRule : IDetectionRule exists in src/Sentinel.Core/Rules.PathProvenance.cs with Name 'IdsCommandLineRule', a [RuleCategory(DetectionCategory.SecurityEvasion)] attribute, and the standard Evaluate(FusedTelemetryContext) signature using static readonly compiled regexes.
Evaluate returns a Tier2Indicator / LogOnly DetectionEvent (Confidence ~0.6) on a known malicious command line and null for benign/empty/null command lines.
The rule is registered as a transient IDetectionRule in BOTH Service and Agent Program.cs next to UnsignedBinaryRule.
dotnet test passes the new IdsCommandLineRule tests (malicious -> Tier2 LogOnly; benign -> null).
dotnet build -c Debug compiles with no errors.
